1392216.summary: Seattle opens the 2026 NFL regular season Wednesday night at Lumen Field in a Super Bowl LX rematch. This is an unusually busy SODO game day: the Mariners host Texas at 1:10 p.m., the {Team}' official Ticketmaster Tailgate opens at 2:00 p.m., all stadium gates open at 3:30 p.m., and fans are asked to be seated by 5:00 p.m. for the Super Bowl LX championship banner unveiling before the 5:20 p.m. kickoff. The Mariners game makes the Lumen Field North Lot and Mariners Garage unavailable for {Team} parking, so transit is strongly preferred.

alerts.title: Mariners game removes major parking inventory
alerts.text: The Mariners host the Texas Rangers at 1:10 p.m. The {Team} state that the Lumen Field North Lot and Mariners Garage are unavailable for {Team} parking, and affected parking-pass holders were sent relocation details.

alerts.title: Be seated by 5:00 p.m. for banner ceremony
alerts.text: The {Team} are asking fans to be in their seats by 5:00 p.m. for the unveiling of the Super Bowl LX championship banner.

alerts.title: No special {Team} Sounder train listed
alerts.text: Sound Transit's current {Team} event-service calendar does not list September 9. Do not rely on a special {Team} Sounder train for this game.

transportation.name: Link light rail
transportation.recommendation: Best overall option for most fans because parking is unusually constrained by the simultaneous Mariners game.
transportation.details: The 1 Line serves Stadium and International District/Chinatown stations near Lumen Field. Allow extra time because the 5:20 p.m. kickoff overlaps the weekday commute.

transportation.name: King County Metro
transportation.recommendation: Useful for Seattle-area trips, especially when paired with walking into the stadium district.
transportation.details: More than 15 regular Metro routes serve stops within roughly three blocks of Lumen Field. Dedicated {Team} park-and-ride game buses are not offered.

transportation.name: Washington State Ferries
transportation.recommendation: Useful for Bainbridge Island and Bremerton fans if the return sailing works with the expected postgame time.
transportation.details: Seattle ferry arrivals at Colman Dock are within walking distance of Lumen Field. Check the current sailing schedule before leaving.

transportation.name: Sounder
transportation.recommendation: Do not plan around a special {Team} event train.
transportation.details: Sound Transit lists special {Team} Sounder service for October 4, October 11, November 8 and December 13, but not September 9. Riders should verify ordinary weekday service and a viable postgame return before using Sounder.

parking.name: Lumen Field North Lot
parking.details: Unavailable for {Team} parking for this game because of the 1:10 p.m. Mariners game.

parking.name: Mariners Garage
parking.details: Unavailable for {Team} parking for this game because of the Mariners afternoon game.

parking.name: Off-site reserved parking
parking.details: The {Team} direct single-game drivers to reserve nearby parking through SpotHero. The Lumen Field North Lot and Lumen Field Garage are sold on a season basis and do not offer normal single-game parking.

timeline.details: The nearby Mariners game creates a direct parking and SODO traffic conflict.
Entry opens for holders of the separate, sold-out USAA Salute 250 Kickoff Concert ticket who also have an active September 9 game ticket. A game ticket alone does not provide concert access.
Official {Team} pregame event inside the Lumen Field Event Center.
The official USAA Salute 250 Kickoff Concert begins in the Lumen Field North Lot and is scheduled to end at 3:45 p.m. It is distinct from the Ticketmaster Tailgate.

timeline.event: Suites and Delta Sky360 Club open

timeline.details: The {Team} ask fans to be in their seats for the Super Bowl LX banner unveiling.
Be in your seat for pregame entertainment and the Super Bowl LX championship-banner unveiling.

tailgates.name: USAA Salute 250 Kickoff Concert featuring Luke Bryan
tailgates.location: Lumen Field North Lot; concert entry at Gate 3
tailgates.description: Official {Team} pregame concert. The event is sold out and required separate concert registration plus an active September 9 game ticket; ordinary game-ticket holders should not assume they have concert access. Concert guests can enter Lumen Field from the North Lot through Gate 2 after the show. This is separate from the general Ticketmaster Tailgate in the Event Center.

tailgates.name: Ticketmaster Tailgate
tailgates.description: The official {Team} pregame event is open to game-ticket holders and includes a Sports Bar for guests 21+, Gaming Zone, kid-friendly activities, concessions, Pro Shop merchandise and live entertainment. Game tickets are scanned when entering the tailgate.

watchParties.name: {Team} vs. Patriots NFL Kickoff Party
watchParties.location: The Dock Sports Bar & Grill, Fremont, Seattle
watchParties.description: The Dock is explicitly advertising a {Team}-Patriots kickoff party from 3:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. with a live DJ, outdoor beer garden and wall-to-wall game coverage.

watchParties.name: {Team} Watch Party
watchParties.location: Tractor Tavern, 5213 Ballard Ave NW, Seattle
watchParties.description: Tractor Tavern's current event calendar lists a {Team} Watch Party beginning at 5:00 p.m.

watchParties.name: Synne Indoor Tailgate: {Team} vs. Patriots
watchParties.location: SYNNE Cellars at Hollywood Schoolhouse, 14810 NE 145th Street Suite B, Woodinville
watchParties.description: SYNNE is explicitly hosting an indoor {Team}-Patriots watch party with the game on all three televisions and sound on.

watchParties.name: Patriots vs. {Team} Watch Party
watchParties.location: Airport Tavern, 5406 S Tacoma Way, Tacoma
watchParties.description: Airport Tavern opens at 4:00 p.m. for its explicitly advertised {Team}-Patriots Banner Night watch party. Game sound will be on, and {Team} gear earns a raffle ticket for halftime prizes.

watchParties.name: Seattle {Team} vs. New England Patriots Watch Party
watchParties.description: Lucky Strike Bellevue's official current event calendar lists a {Team}-Patriots watch party for September 9 hosted by @IamDhayes. The calendar does not provide a verified start time in the surfaced listing, so none is stated here.

stadiumTips.title: Clear-bag policy
stadiumTips.details: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags may not exceed 12 x 6 x 12 inches. One-gallon clear freezer bags are allowed, as are small clutch bags no larger than 4.5 x 6.5 inches.

stadiumTips.title: All {Team} tickets are mobile
stadiumTips.details: Download or update the {Team} mobile app and save tickets before approaching the stadium.

stadiumTips.title: No tailgating on Lumen Field property
stadiumTips.details: Traditional tailgating is not permitted in Lumen Field-owned parking areas. The {Team} recommend the indoor Ticketmaster Tailgate for ticketed guests.

stadiumTips.title: Super Bowl LX banner celebration
stadiumTips.details: Week 1 is officially themed NFL Kickoff and Super Bowl LX Banner Celebration.

weather.summary: Mostly sunny during the day and partly cloudy Wednesday night. Dry conditions are expected.
weather.temperature: High near 75°F; temperatures around kickoff should be near the low 70s before cooling through the evening.

1392244.summary: Seattle's first road game is a 1:25 p.m. Pacific kickoff at State Farm Stadium in Glendale. watchParties.name: Seattle {Team} vs. Arizona Cardinals

stadiumTips.title: Use the NFL clear-bag format

1392256.summary: Seattle visits Washington for the Commanders' home opener at 1:00 p.m. Eastern. Washington has already announced a new stadium-wide pregame production called The Show debuting specifically at this {Team} game, and fans attending are advised to be seated 30 minutes before kickoff.

alerts.title: Commanders recommend being seated 30 minutes early

parking.name: Northwest Stadium official parking
parking.details: A pre-purchased parking pass is required for official stadium lots. Lots open three hours before the game, except the Redzone Lot, which opens four hours before the game.

timeline.details: Washington recommends fans be seated 30 minutes before the 1:00 p.m. Eastern kickoff for The Show.

stadiumTips.title: Mobile tickets only

stadiumTips.title: Clear-bag policy
stadiumTips.details: Clear bags may not exceed 12 x 6 x 12 inches; one-gallon clear freezer bags and small clutch bags are also permitted.

stadiumTips.title: Several common items are prohibited
stadiumTips.details: Northwest Stadium prohibits items including umbrellas, outside food and beverages, computers, tablets, large bags and many camera accessories.

stadiumTips.title: No tailgating on Lumen Field property

1392467.summary: Seattle visits Carolina for a 10:00 a.m. Pacific kickoff in Week 17. {Team}-specific Charlotte tailgates and Puget Sound watch parties have not yet been reliably announced. Fans traveling should plan to verify January parking and transit information closer to game day.

transportation.name: Charlotte public transit
transportation.recommendation: Consider transit rather than driving into Uptown Charlotte.
transportation.details: The Panthers identify local transit as an alternative to stadium-area driving. Recheck January service before travel.

parking.name: Uptown Charlotte parking
parking.details: The Panthers state that more than 30,000 parking spaces are available within roughly a 10-15 minute walk of Bank of America Stadium, primarily through independent operators. Advance reservation is recommended.

1392478.summary: Seattle closes the regular season on the road against the Rams at SoFi Stadium. As of September 8, the NFL still lists the Week 18 date, kickoff time and television assignment as TBD, so no exact calendar date is inserted here. The NFL states that Week 18 games will be assigned to Saturday or Sunday after Week 17.

alerts.title: Week 18 date and kickoff time are not finalized
alerts.text: The NFL and {Team} currently list {Team} at Rams as TBD. Do not publish a January 9 or January 10 date as final until the league announces Week 18 scheduling after Week 17.

transportation.name: SoFi Stadium public transportation
transportation.recommendation: Consider transit once the Week 18 kickoff is finalized.
transportation.details: The Rams' 2026 transportation guide directs fans to current Metro and stadium-shuttle options. Recheck operating hours after the NFL announces the date and time.

transportation.name: Rideshare
transportation.recommendation: Use the designated stadium rideshare zone rather than arranging curbside pickup.
transportation.details: The Rams designate the rideshare area north of SoFi Stadium on Kareem Court via Pincay Drive and recommend 3178 Pincay Dr., Inglewood, for pickup and drop-off requests.

parking.name: SoFi Stadium on-site parking
parking.details: Parking must be purchased in advance. The Rams state there is no event-day on-site parking sale at SoFi Stadium, and current season parking inventory is sold out, with single-game passes available through resale.

parking.name: City of Inglewood Park & Go
parking.details: The Rams identify Inglewood Park & Go as an official off-site alternative.

timeline.details: The NFL will assign the Week 18 date and kickoff time after Week 17.

stadiumTips.title: Tailgating only in the Pink Zone
stadiumTips.details: NFL tailgating at SoFi Stadium is permitted only in the Pink Zone. The Pink Zone opens five hours before kickoff.

stadiumTips.title: Other parking zones open four hours before kickoff
stadiumTips.details: The Rams state that regular parking zones open four hours before kickoff.

stadiumTips.title: Mobile tickets only
stadiumTips.details: SoFi Stadium does not accept print-at-home tickets or screenshots because mobile ticket barcodes rotate.

stadiumTips.title: NFL clear-bag policy
stadiumTips.details: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches and small bags not exceeding 4.5 x 6.5 inches are permitted.
